scope: entity snapshot format recovered; a 10 KB multi-snapshot body was not acknowledged

snapshot_chain.has_base_bit: 0x47238C reads one bit; the base pointer is passed to the first sub-block, or 0 when the bit is clear

entity_encoding.entity_number_table: 0x671650: read 1 bit (table present); if 1 read 1 bit again; if 1 call 0x66ED70 for an 8-bit entity count, then 12 bits per entity number (0x66EC30 with width 0xC)
entity_encoding.field_reader: 0x671700: read 1 bit (changed); if 1 read 2 bits and add 1 to choose the value form; otherwise read another bit for the reduced form
entity_encoding.bit_reader: 0x447190 reads one bit and advances the bit cursor

correction_0x671D80.finding: 0x671D80 is not a bit reader. It allocates/copies a 0x3B7C-byte baseline (test [ebp+0xC]; jne 0x671FE5 when a base pointer is supplied) and fills timing fields from QueryPerformanceCounter helpers.
correction_0x671D80.meaning: the has_base bit at 0x47238C only selects which baseline buffer is used; the bit stream for entities starts at 0x471D80
correction_0x671D80.impact: a hand-built base snapshot needs opcode 0 + serverTime(4) + delta/flags + has_base bit, then the entity number table and field deltas; no opaque pre-block bits are required
